Ransomware Recovery Readiness Assessment
The RRRA evaluates an organization's ability to restore critical systems, data, and business operations following a ransomware attack or other destructive cybersecurity incident. This assessment measures the effectiveness of backup strategies, recovery procedures, disaster recovery planning, business continuity capabilities, and recovery activities.
